problem: Cross-system visual assurance could still drift if the GitHub executor, Supabase sync/quality authority or Notion projection reference were removed independently.
root_cause: The earlier contract described the three surfaces but did not make every authority identifier and terminal integration edge machine-readable in one file.
decision: Promote all GitHub, Supabase and Notion authority identifiers into the canonical visual-assurance contract and enforce them with a terminal Brain regression.
prevention: Exact Notion verified-state and System Map page IDs are part of the machine contract.
Supabase sync function, migration, cron and quality registry are part of the machine contract.
CI fails if any authority edge or freshness/fail-closed rule is removed.
